mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, sku_code, name, pricing_mode, public_price, original_price, priority, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{skuCode}, #{name}, #{pricingMode}, #{publicPrice}, #{originalPrice}, #{priority}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM product WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET is_active = 0, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
